1.title: Judge Denounces Trump’s I.R.S. Suit as Improper Exercise in Self-Dealing
1.summary: The decision also recommended disciplinary action against the lawyers involved, including the acting attorney general, Todd Blanche.

2.title: How Lindsey Graham’s Journey From Trump Critic to Ally Made Him a Power Player
2.summary: He initially called Donald Trump a “kook” who was “unfit for office,” only to join the new president’s Mar-a-Lago circle. “I’m still in the game,” Mr. Graham once explained of his much-analyzed turnabout.

3.title: Authorities Investigate Fatal Shooting in Biddeford, Maine, Involving Federal Agents
3.summary: The killing occurred in Biddeford, about 20 miles south of Portland. The Trump administration has been conducting a surge of immigration enforcement.

4.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Edge Toward War Again
4.summary: After more escalatory rhetoric and attacks, President Trump said the United States was renewing its shipping blockade to and from Iran, and would charge a 20 percent fee on goods passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

5.title: A Robot Army Remakes Ground Warfare in Ukraine
5.summary: They began as supply mules. Now ground robots evacuate the wounded, hold trenches and even do the killing.

6.title: UK-Switzerland deal to scrap roaming charges and allow Britons to use e-gates
6.summary: The UK signs a new services deal with Switzerland it says will increase exports by £5.2bn annually "in the long run".
